definition: The process of SNR dissolving the SNT bonding layer and forcibly separating cybernetic implants from the body. Takes 2-8 hours. Leaves wounds shaped exactly like the implants. Considered worse than death by many augmented individuals because it strips your identity without killing you.
origin: Medical terminology — returning the body to its pre-augmented state, except the body remembers what it lost
example: Reversion isn't amputation. Amputation takes a limb. Reversion takes who you are.
